intent: Compare the share of new oil and gas wells attributed to fracking versus non-fracking methods across the full scope.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the share of new oil and gas wells attributed to fracking versus non-fracking methods across the full scope.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Fracking accounts for 60% of new oil and gas wells, compared with 40% for non-fracking methods, within the full composition.
accept: Fracking share is 60% and non-fracking share is 40% of new oil and gas wells
Fracking is the larger share (60%) versus non-fracking (40%)
The two shares sum to the full composition (100%)
reject: Only fracking share is shown without the non-fracking comparison
Only non-fracking share is shown without the fracking comparison
Shares are presented as absolute well counts rather than shares of the whole
The comparison is made across separate panels or rings rather than within one full composition

optional_valid: Displaying the non-fracking 40% as an inferred remainder of the full ring
Labeling both sectors with their printed percentages
unsupported_to_avoid: Adding fracking and non-fracking shares together as if they were separate panels
Reporting absolute well counts not present in the data
Introducing time-series change since the clip is a snapshot
Treating the non-fracking remainder as a separate whole
review_notes: The intent asks for a comparison of two named parts within one full composition, so a single composition_order unit captures both shares and their ordering.
Non-fracking is a printed remainder row (r2) with relative_value 0.4; it is part of the same whole and should not be split into a separate inferred_remainder unit.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
